messages:
support_jess: FYI - Acme (acct: acme-42) opened an escalation: app failing to decrypt keys in their Private deployment. Errors show 'key access path timeout' and repeated 502s. Can eng/infra take a look?
customer_acme_ops: seeing this since 02:00 UTC. App logs: `ERROR KMS_ACCESS_TIMEOUT: failed to connect to kms-proxy.acme.internal:443 (i/o timeout)`
customer_acme_ops: repro steps: 1) deploy service to private subnet, 2) call /v1/generate which triggers key fetch, 3) observe repeated retries then 502. Happens across multiple pods.
eng_miguel: can you paste dig/traceroute/openssl output to kms-proxy? also which NAT/egress setup?
customer_acme_ops: digging now - output: `dig +short kms-proxy.acme.internal` -> `10.5.20.3` then intermittently `; <<>> DiG 9.16.1 <<>> kms-proxy.acme.internal` "status: NXDOMAIN". also attached a short openssl test: `openssl s_client -connect 10.5.20.3:443 -servername kms.acme` -> handshake fails: ``
CONNECTED(00000003)
139783247123456:error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert handshake failure:ssl/record/rec_layer_s3.c:1543:
``
kms_bot: [alert] 2026-08-15T02:03:12Z - repeated KMS proxy connection failures detected for acme-42 (5/5). Suggest checking egress allowlist and client certs.
infra_zoe: seeing a pattern: tcpdump from one of your nodes shows `10.0.0.12:53872 -> 10.5.20.3:443` then immediate `RST, ACK` from 10.5.20.3. That usually indicates a firewall or port-probe deny on the target side or an SNI/cipher mismatch causing connection closure. Do you have a stateful firewall that only allows a limited ephemeral port range?
customer_acme_ops: our firewall team confirmed we only explicitly allow outbound 443 and 80, but they locked ephemeral source ports to a small range due to older policy. Could that cause resets?
infra_zoe: yes - if your SNAT maps to source ports outside the allowed range, stateful firewall may drop/close flows. We typically recommend allowing outbound ephemeral range 1024-65535 or at least 49152-65535. Also ensure destination IPs for the HSM/KMS cluster are allowed (10.5.20.0/24). Example policy snippet they can add: `ALLOW tcp 10.0.0.0/8 -> 10.5.20.0/24 dport 443` and `ALLOW tcp ephemeral 10.0.0.0/8 -> 10.5.20.0/24 sport 1024-65535` (policy UI varies).
sec_raj: additional point: our logs show the client cert presented by acme expired yesterday. Run: `openssl s_client -connect 10.5.20.3:443 -showcerts -servername kms.acme` and check the `notAfter`. Example from your output: `subject=CN = acme-kms-client` `notAfter=Feb 10 12:00:00 2026 GMT` -> expired. If mutual TLS is required the server will drop handshake.
eng_miguel: thanks - combo of expired client cert + restrictive ephemeral port mapping would explain intermittent NXDOMAIN/handshake behavior (DNS flaps from internal HA + connection resets). Steps: 1) rotate client cert, 2) open ephemeral outbound ports on your firewall or add explicit egress rules for 10.5.20.0/24:443, 3) ensure SNI is forwarded if you terminate TLS on a proxy (no TLS termination in path unless certs match).
support_jess: @customer_acme_ops can you confirm firewall team can open ephemeral range or add the CIDR allowlist? also please rotate the client cert and paste the `openssl` notAfter/subject once done. We'll escalate to eng_oncall if they need help.
customer_acme_ops: firewall team will add 10.5.20.0/24:443 to allowlist, and open 49152-65535 ephemeral range temporarily. Rotating cert now.
customer_acme_ops: after rotation and firewall change - quick test: `curl -v --resolve kms.acme:443:10.5.20.3 https://kms.acme/health` -> `* Connected to 10.5.20.3 (10.5.20.3) port 443 (#0)` `* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Finished` `HTTP/1.1 200 OK` - looks good from one node.
eng_oncall: great — can you run a short load test to confirm stability across pods? also check DNS TTLs and controller that manages internal records (we saw NXDOMAIN earlier possibly from a failing DNS sync). If DNS is flaky, add a short retry/backoff in your KMS client to handle transient NXDOMAIN.
customer_acme_ops: running smoke across 10 pods now, no KMS errors for 15m. will monitor and follow up if anything else. thanks team!
support_jess: marking as resolved pending 24h observation. reopening if customer reports regression. :white_check_mark:
